crossRefs.note: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.
Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.
Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.
Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Defend the fatherless. Plead for the widow.”
My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will…
I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.
Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.
Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.
You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,
For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered…
But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,
that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.
Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?
Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.
If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.
For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

translations.web: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.
translations.bsb: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is of God; the one who does evil has not seen God.
translations.kjv: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath ➔ not seen God.
translations.asv: Beloved, imitate not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
